limitations: Property-comment candidate selection does not prove exhaustive revision-content coverage.
Wikidata revision timestamps are observations, not effective dates.
Directory corroboration and code-property revisions do not establish actual effective allocation dates.
All event groups were joined mechanically; this is not substantive resolution of 88330 histories.
All-rank Wikidata statement discovery includes deprecated assertions; deprecated status does not certify historical truth.
Revision acquisition uses property-edit comments and cannot guarantee detection of uncommented or bulk-import code edits.
OSM current-object discovery misses deleted objects absent from current Overpass results; targeted history does not solve that global gap.
FAA supports only 2458 US ICAO continuity proposals over the stated October 2026 core; global historical effective-date coverage remains incomplete.
Evidence-ready FAA proposals are not admitted: existing Owner source/claim scopes must authorize any formal intake. No existing grant is extended.

Wikidata qualifier dates normalize low precision to day-like strings in SPARQL; qualified-relationship-review.json retains original precision, including EDDB year/month qualifiers. None of the three two-sided qualifiers is admitted.
